page.notes: The right page is cut off at the scan edge; most of its words are illegible and only the outlines of its short entries can be seen. The Greek forms on the left page, especially the accents and the names in Σαβανὰς, Σεβαστὸς and Σεκουνδὸς, are doubtful. The Hebrew in the entry for Σάρων is a damaged word, and its letters could not be read. The right-hand entries were reconstructed only roughly from the fragments visible.
